open_items: GAP SPEC, filed 2026-07-16 from operator's 2026-07-15 night idea: anticipatory governance — human moves from runtime operator to design-time legislator ('human over the loop'). Pack = question -> admissible answer classes -> per-answer evidence requirements -> derived permissions -> escalation rules; agent instantiates answers FROM EVIDENCE (NLAI: pointers, governor verifies), novelty = typed escalation trigger. Census says ~90% of parts exist (intent_compiler forms/escape classification, RationCard doctrine, Layer-3 evidence kinds, S7 containment, Z3 lint substrate, docket precedent); the genuinely new seams: (2) evidence-instantiation check (answer admissible only when bound to verified evidence — validate_response checks well-formed, nothing checks EVIDENCED), (3) closed-world novelty fence, (4) doctrine lint pre-deploy, (5) pack decay/anti-YAML-burial (stale pack degrades to interactive, never keeps spending). NO new effect authority: packs change WHEN the human decides, never how much an agent may do. 4 OQs incl. whether ratified packs are custody-affecting per se (OQ-C) and orientation!=evidence for pack answers (OQ-D).
wake_condition: operator ratification of the pack concept + a forcing case: a real project whose interactive-loop question set is stable enough to legislate (the walking-skeleton or a public-mvp consumer), OR the staged-ops sibling gets ruled first (its incident-class doctrine IS a pack instance and would force the artifact shape).
